title: GPT-6-astra Scores 53.6% on New Humanity's Sixth Sense Benchmark
summary:
Scale AI and Elorian AI have released a multimodal evaluation measuring the ability of artificial intelligence to navigate images and video with everyday human intuition. The project, named Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), uses 522 open ended tasks to test spatial, causal, and social reasoning. In initial results, the median AI model scored 30.9%, while humans averaged 93.1%.

GPT-6-astra was the top performing model in the test but reached only 53.6%. Co-creator Andrew Dai noted that the benchmark exposes a blind spot where models that can write professional code fail to identify basic visual facts, such as whether a bookshelf has room for an additional book.

We’re introducing Humanity’s Sixth Sense, a new benchmark testing the intuitive visual reasoning people rely on every day.

Across 522 open-ended tasks spanning images and video, HSS tests everything from spatial and causal reasoning to social understanding.

The gap is significant. Humans score 93.1%, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches 53.6%. The median model scores just 30.9%.
